title: docs(adr) + skills: ADR-0144 Open item 13 — record ruling 6670707546 (organization-scoped backfill, tenant-admin door, operations interim) and the `--org` skills line (multi-currency, epic #8345)
body:
epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZWjnSeed8H4dMjt9d

Blocked-by: #30674

Part of #8345. Filed by the epic PM from ruling 6670707546 (letter C), ruling execution items ④ and ⑤; #30102 (PR #30182) merged before the ruling, so this is its own close-out card. ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling-ref: 6670707546

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 在 ADR-0144 开放项 13 下加一条注记，记下裁决 C：回填按组织走（CLI `--org`，多组织无 `--org` 拒跑，`--all-organizations` 显式），另开租户管理员 REST 入口；B 落地前云租户由平台运维带 `--org` 代跑，这是过渡态而不是答案。skills 里提到回填命令的一行补上 `--org`。
- **为什么改：** ADR 每有裁决就要修订；skills 要与 A 卡落地后的命令行为一致。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯文字；Tier H（`docs/adr/**`、`skills/**`）。
- **先看：** 裁决评论 6670707546。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm check:adr-anchors`、`pnpm check:adr-index` 退出 0。
- **需要您做的：** 契约复审 PASS 与席位 ACCEPT 后，由 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准。

## Task

- [ ] ADR-0144 Open item 13: a dated `*Note:*` recording ruling 6670707546 (C = A + B; what was not chosen and why, in one line each), with tree evidence from the A card's merged PR by file#symbol.
- [ ] The interim, worded as an interim: until the REST door (B card) lands, a cloud-managed tenant's backfill is run by platform operations on request with `--org`. Item 13 stays open on its B half until that card lands.
- [ ] `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:174` ("Backfill: `os migrate record-currency-codes`"): add `--org <id>` (and that a multi-organization database refuses without it), matching the A card's merged behavior.

Lane: epic-carried (governed docs) · Size: S · Model: fable (dispatch-gates `docs/adr/**` mandate), effort xhigh · Review: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER. `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Dedupe: #30102 (merged, settled items 2/3/4/6/9; item 13 left as it was); no open card carries item 13's ruling.
